return $('Config').all().map(it => ({ json: { body: {
  filterGroups: [
    { filters: [
      { propertyName: 'hs_timestamp', operator: 'GTE', value: String(it.json.fromMs) },
      { propertyName: 'hs_timestamp', operator: 'LT', value: String(it.json.toMs) },
      { propertyName: 'hs_email_direction', operator: 'EQ', value: 'EMAIL' },
      { propertyName: 'hs_email_status', operator: 'EQ', value: 'SENT' }]},
    { filters: [
      { propertyName: 'hs_timestamp', operator: 'GTE', value: String(it.json.fromMs) },
      { propertyName: 'hs_timestamp', operator: 'LT', value: String(it.json.toMs) },
      { propertyName: 'hs_email_direction', operator: 'EQ', value: 'INCOMING_EMAIL' }]}
  ],
  properties: ['hs_email_subject','hs_timestamp','hs_email_direction','hs_email_open_count','hs_email_click_count','hs_sequence_id'],
  sorts: [{ propertyName: 'hs_object_id', direction: 'ASCENDING' }], limit: 200 } } }));
